name: Shadow warriors

variantInfo.name: Shadow warrior
notes: A fighter from the supernatural world; attacks with slash melee at scimitar speed despite the battleaxe appearance.

locationComparison.name: Legends' Guild Dungeon
notes: 19 spawns; the sole Shadow warrior location.
Safespot through the fence by the pit scorpions or behind the fungus near the cavern wall.
Multicombat and cannon placement are not wiki-stated; conservative defaults are used.

taskNotes: Shadow warriors require 60 combat and completion of Legends' Quest to be assigned; there is no Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 249 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract: 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Shadow warriors are found only in the Legends' Guild Dungeon (19 spawns).
They are not undead despite their ghostly appearance, so the Salve amulet does not apply.
Crush is their weakest melee defence (+19); stab (+43) and ranged (+38) are their strongest defences.
They can be safespotted through the fence separating them from the pit scorpions, or behind the fungus near the cavern wall.
They attack with slash melee at scimitar speed with a max hit of 6 and are hidden on the minimap.
No task extension unlock exists for Shadow warriors.
recommendedMethod: Kill the 19 Legends' Guild Dungeon shadow warriors with a crush weapon against their weakest defence, or safespot through the fence by the pit scorpions with ranged or magic. Low max hit makes this a low-risk task.
